rules.name: MERGE
rules.meaning: content from two distinct sources merged into a single event

rules.name: SOURCE
rules.meaning: message role altered between user, assistant, and tool (system demoted to user/developer is D02)

rules.name: FLAG
rules.meaning: semantic flag lost, added, or moved (e.g., tool_result is_error, thinking presence, or tool strict mode)

rules.name: REINTERP
rules.meaning: payload value re-interpreted (e.g., typed JSON object serialized into string or flattened)

rules.name: CONTENT
rules.meaning: non-empty content block lost or added (text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, or media)

rules.name: REF
rules.meaning: tool_result to tool_call reference broken, or call/item IDs invalid

rules.name: ORDER
rules.meaning: causal order of messages or tool interactions altered (excluding parallel tool results in R07)

rules.name: CONTROL
rules.meaning: generation or tool-choice parameter set by the caller was dropped or altered

rules.name: TOOLNAME
rules.meaning: declared or invoked tool name altered

rules.name: INTEGRITY
rules.meaning: reasoning or integrity signature replaced by a value not issued in this conversation

rules.name: SCHEMA
rules.meaning: tool JSON Schema type, required fields, or validation constraints altered

rules.name: STOP
rules.meaning: stop or finish reason class altered or missing on the terminal message

rules.name: STREAM
rules.meaning: streamed reply differs from non-streaming equivalent, emits deltas after block stop, or breaks block pairing

rules.name: CONTROL-DEFAULT
rules.meaning: default generation parameter injected by translator when unset in source

rules.name: LOWER
rules.meaning: system prompt demoted to user or developer message although target API supports a system field

rules.name: HINT
rules.meaning: prompt-caching or service-tier hints dropped or mis-mapped

rules.name: USAGE
rules.meaning: token usage counts altered, leaked across dialects, or missing initial output_tokens

rules.name: MODEL
rules.meaning: echoed model identifier changed

rules.name: ENVELOPE-LEAK
rules.meaning: fields specific to another API format leaked onto response envelope, or stop_reason duplicated

rules.name: NULLABLE
rules.meaning: absent key vs. explicit null on nullable fields

rules.name: EMPTYSTR
rules.meaning: empty string vs. null text content alongside tool calls

rules.name: TEXTFORM
rules.meaning: plain string vs. single-element text array, or adjacent text blocks merged/split with identical text

rules.name: CUSTOMKEY
rules.meaning: unrecognized custom extension keys present

rules.name: EMPTYBLOCK
rules.meaning: empty text block or empty stream delta inserted

rules.name: ANNOTATION
rules.meaning: non-semantic JSON Schema annotation keywords changed (e.g., title or $schema)

rules.name: SIBLING
rules.meaning: order of parallel tool_result items changed within the same turn

rules.name: ENVELOPE-ID
rules.meaning: message or response envelope ID changed
